answer: By the willow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The cipher lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the plume is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
